newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi Arabia launches locally built APC.
newsitem.headline: Saudi Arabia launches locally built APC.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Wednesday opened a factory to launch production of the kingdom's first locally built armoured personnel carrier (APC).
The official Saudi Press Agency (SPA) said Minister of Defence and Aviation Prince Sultan inaugurated the plant in Dammam in eastern Saudi Arabia.
Saudi state television showed footage of a prototype of the APC moving through a pool of water and over an obstacle below a reviewing stand as the defence minister and other officials looked on.

Abdallah al-Faris, chairman of Abdallah Al-Faris Heavy Industries, the manufacturer of the APC, was quoted by the Saudi Gazette newspaper on Wednesday as saying the vehicle would be capable of long-range amphibious operations.
Company officials said production of the APC would reach about 50 units this year and would rise to 150 from 1998, the newspaper reported.
It said the project marked the kingdom's entry in the production of military vehicles.
Al-Faris said the company was aiming to supply the international market and would be manufacturing other combat vehicles, including anti-riot trucks.
